fable_home_title_visible.label: Home: show the page title
fable_home_title_visible.description: Show the title at the top of the home page. When off, it is hidden from view but kept for screen readers and search engines.

show_story_count.label: Home: show the story count
show_story_count.description: Show "N stories on this page" beside the home page title.

fable_home_top_stories.label: Home: show the top stories strip
fable_home_top_stories.description: Show the ranked strip of top stories above the home page.

fable_home_top_stories_rank.label: Home: top stories strip numbers
fable_home_top_stories_rank.description: Show the big number before each headline in the top stories strip.

fable_home_cover.label: Home: show the cover story
fable_home_cover.description: Show the cover story with its picture and headline card at the top of the home page.

fable_home_cover_kicker.label: Home: cover story section name
fable_home_cover_kicker.description: Show the section name above the cover story headline.

fable_home_cover_standfirst.label: Home: cover story standfirst
fable_home_cover_standfirst.description: Show the short summary under the cover story headline.

fable_home_cover_byline.label: Home: cover story byline
fable_home_cover_byline.description: Show the author and date under the cover story.

fable_home_also_today.label: Home: show Also today
fable_home_also_today.description: Show the row of small stories under the cover story. When off, the newest stories it would have shown move into the grid.

fable_home_also_today_kicker.label: Home: Also today section names
fable_home_also_today_kicker.description: Show the section name above each small headline in Also today.

fable_home_also_today_thumb.label: Home: Also today pictures
fable_home_also_today_thumb.description: Show the small square picture beside each headline in Also today.

fable_home_ad_leaderboard.label: Home: show the wide ad under Also today
fable_home_ad_leaderboard.description: Show the wide advertisement spot under Also today. It also needs the site-wide ads switch to be on.

fable_home_ad_in_feed.label: Home: show the ad inside the story grid
fable_home_ad_in_feed.description: Show the advertisement spot inside the grid of stories. It also needs the site-wide ads switch to be on.

fable_home_ad_rectangle.label: Home: show the ad beside Most read
fable_home_ad_rectangle.description: Show the box advertisement spot beside Most read. It also needs the site-wide ads switch to be on.

fable_home_long_read.label: Home: show the long read block
fable_home_long_read.description: Show the coloured long read block of the home page.

fable_home_grid.label: Home: show the story grid
fable_home_grid.description: Show the More to explore grid of stories, with its page links.

show_layout_toggle.label: Home: story grid layout buttons
show_layout_toggle.description: Let readers switch the story grid between a grid and a list.

fable_home_sections.label: Home: show From the sections
fable_home_sections.description: Show the From the sections band of up to four section lists.

fable_home_most_read.label: Home: show Most read
fable_home_most_read.description: Show the Most read list near the bottom of the home page.

fable_home_most_read_rank.label: Home: Most read numbers
fable_home_most_read_rank.description: Show the number beside each story in Most read.
